expr: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));for(let i=0;i<150&&!(window.Defense&&document.querySelector('.df-canvas'));i++)await w(100);await w(500);const d=Defense,s=d.sim;s.gold=900;const types=['monkey','giraffe','elephant'];[0,2,3,5,6,8].forEach((i,k)=>{d.S.placeTower(s,i,types[k%3])});s.towers.forEach((t,k)=>{if(k%2===0)d.S.upgrade(s,t);if(k===0)d.S.upgrade(s,t)});s.gold=75;d.S.startWave(s,false);await w(9000);return '塔='+s.towers.length+' 敵人='+s.enemies.length+' 波='+s.waveNo})()
